issue: Physical Android phone remains at waiting for computer response / reconnecting after selecting a project

physicalEvidence.platform: Windows x64 Manager 0.2.2; HONOR PTP-AN70 peer
physicalEvidence.tcp: retry-connections.jsonl shows established connections followed by close/retry during user-confirmed phone retry
physicalEvidence.threads: retry-0.json through retry-7.json repeatedly show SSLStreams.<init> -> InetSocketAddress.getHostName -> InetAddress.getHostFromNameService -> Inet6AddressImpl.getHostByAddr
physicalEvidence.failureStage: Reverse DNS before TLS handshake and before RemoteGateway route handler

fix.implementation: Standard InetAddressResolverProvider, enabled only in Manager process, returns numeric names for LAN peers; delegates forward and non-LAN reverse lookups
fix.packaging: SPI resource is packaged and included in runtime input hash and file inventory

verification.blockedDnsTls: Original HTTPS blocked; repaired HTTPS completed while reverse resolver remained blocked; certificate pin and unpaired access rejection checked
verification.physicalPlaybackAfterFix: User confirmed after installed Manager restart: retried and game picture appeared
verification.installedProjectAndPairing: Path of Kings and HONOR PTP-AN70 retained
verification.postUpdateEvidence: tmp/remote-physical-diagnostic/fixed-phone-connections.jsonl and fixed-phone-*.json show the phone connecting and the real project preparation running without reverse DNS blocking
verification.firewall: No firewall settings changed. A proposed rule was rejected by automatic review; installation and live phone verification succeeded without it.
verification.physicalTouchAndFps: Not measured in this turn; physical confirmation covers game picture after project connection
verification.macOS: Portable Java implementation; not executed on macOS in this turn
